entities.summary: Magnus Tideman is a former professional tennis player from Sweden. He won one doubles title and achieved a career-high of World No. 43 in 1988. In singles, he reached the quarterfinals of Toulouse in 1982 and achieved a career-high ranking of World No. 76 in 1983. Tideman also defeated Manuel Orantes at the 1983 French Open. Magnus Tideman was a athletes & competitors from Uppsala (b. 1963-04-09, Uppsala). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
